text:
morgan: Heads-up: Silvergate is seeing 502/503 spikes on their dedicated pool during peak. Customer flagged P0. Can eng-platform own immediate triage?
oncall-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-342 Silvergate P0
jasmin: I can take infra triage. First checks: autoscale events, recent config changes, or canary rollouts?
liam: Quick look at logs — surge of kvcache misses + worker OOMs around 17:24UTC. snippet:
```
17:24:12 worker-3 OOM
17:24:13 kvcache miss rate 0.98
17:24:14 503 upstream timeout
```
morgan: Thx. Note Silvergate is on Reserved Dedicated (no shared fallback by default). SLA at risk if >15m downtime. Short-term workaround: route traffic to fallback region + reduce per-worker concurrency.
jasmin: Can we toggle fallback routing immediately? Who owns routing policy/config?
liam: eng-platform owns routing. I can flip a canary to route 50% -> fallback in ~5m. Do we need product sign-off for a customer-visible routing change?
product-lead: Approve the canary. Prioritize uptime over perf. Push the canary and let CS know. Also start a CR for RC/root cause tracking.
liam: Executing canary now. Command I ran: `kubectl patch routingconfig silvergate --patch '{"spec": {"canary": 50}}'`
deploy-bot: routing canary started for silvergate — 50% traffic -> fallback region (canary id c-7845)
sre-bot: Notes: autoscale burst was disabled earlier this shift due to a memory leak. Re-enabling burst may reduce latency but risks more OOMs; consider increasing node memory until root cause fixed.
jasmin: I'll re-enable burst and spin up a short-lived +2 GPU pool as stopgap. ETA ~10m.
morgan: Owners: jasmin (infra), liam (routing), arya (customer comms). I'm assigning the incident to this triage group and notifying CS.
arya: CS pinged. They need ETA and rollback plan — will give them 30m ETA and confirm that we can rollback routing to pre-canary state quickly.
morgan: Tracking milestones: triage (15m), canary live (5m), evaluate metrics (10m), full cutover or rollback decision (30m), postmortem CR opened. Any objections?
liam: :thumbsup: No objections. I'll post updated logs and PR refs once I have them.
oncall-bot: incident updated: status=mitigating, owners=[jasmin, liam, arya], updated_ts=1759876850
